props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change during a drag and on every key press.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being transformed, for the accessible name — "Logo", "Photo".

props.name: children
props.description: The content inside the frame. It is stretched to the frame.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Smallest width a resize can reach.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Smallest height a resize can reach.

props.name: lockAspectRatio
props.description: Always keep the aspect ratio, as if Shift were held.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Hide the handles and ignore input.
